artifacts.notes: The press route https://press.vatican.va/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_decree_19641121_unitatis-redintegratio_lt.html and content-delivery route https://www.vatican.va/content/dam/wss/archive/hist_councils/ii_vatican_council/documents/vat-ii_decree_19641121_unitatis-redintegratio_lt.html returned byte-identical 66227-byte responses with this SHA-256 on 2026-07-24; the aliases are not duplicated. The response contains articles 1-24, formula and date, and a 43-entry subscription block abridged relative to the Acta. It then appends the distinct Lumen gentium Notificationes, embedded 6 March 1964 Doctrinal Commission declaration, and complete Nota explicativa praevia, with Pericle Felici's signature, before presenting Unitatis Redintegratio's notes. Those three works are not part of this Decree, and the response omits the remaining subscriptions and final attestations printed in the Acta. Exact bytes are identified but not retained.
artifacts.rights_basis: The Vatican portal Legal Notes, reviewed 2026-07-24 at https://www.vatican.va/content/vatican/en/legal-notes.html, limit portal content to personal and non-profit viewing and prohibit collection, reproduction, dissemination, or transfer without prior written authorization from the Dicastery for Communication. No repository redistribution permission was established.

edition.notes: A dated Vatican delivery state of the Latin Decree. The exact response contains articles 1-24, formula and date, an abridged subscription block, and consolidated notes. Between the subscriptions and the Decree's notes, the delivery page appends the distinct Lumen gentium Notificationes, the Doctrinal Commission declaration of 6 March 1964, and the complete Nota explicativa praevia; those separate works are not absorbed into this edition.
edition.publication: Holy See Latin web presentation of Unitatis Redintegratio, retrieved 2026-07-24
edition.title: Unitatis Redintegratio — Vatican Latin web state

work.author: Second Vatican Council
work.description: The Second Vatican Council's Decree on Ecumenism, solemnly promulgated by Pope Paul VI on 21 November 1964. Its numbered articles 1-24 state Catholic principles and practices for the restoration of Christian unity and address separated Eastern Churches and Western ecclesial communities.
work.title: Unitatis Redintegratio
